units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:3">Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ</cite> top; ib. III, 23ᶜ this one day has become <he>ה׳ לכל הימים</he> a precedent by which to judge all other days.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:4:3">Y. Nidd. II, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוֹכֵיחָהּ קיים</he> her evidence (the cloth with which she examined herself) exists; Bab.
